businessPlan: Domain intent: when a project explicitly enables Serena semanticNavigation in external mode for a role, that role should receive narrowly tailored prompt guidance explaining how to use semantic navigation safely. Brain guidance is for orientation and converting findings into self-contained delegation with concrete file/symbol references. Coder guidance is for symbol/reference lookup before edits, exact built-in file inspection before final edits, and runnable validation after semantic edits. Reviewer guidance is for changed-symbol/reference/diagnostic coverage while preserving behavioral evidence requirements. When Serena is disabled or a role is off, prompts must remain unchanged so existing workflows are behavior-compatible.
technicalPlan: Add a pure prompt-composition layer in extensions/workflow/prompts.ts that knows how to decide whether semanticNavigation is active for a role (enabled=true, provider=serena, mode=external, role access readonly/edit) and returns role-specific guidance blocks. Phase A creates and tests these isolated helpers without touching brain-workflow.ts or delegate transports. Phase B wires the helper through the existing getAgentPreset seam in extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts so Brain before_agent_start and coder/reviewer delegates automatically receive the appended block from the already-loaded WorkflowConfig. Preserve DEFAULT_CONFIG prompt constants and default tool profiles; do not hard-code Serena tool names in runtime role logic; do not change finalization/evidence gates.
parallelAssessment: serial. The task carries brain:parallel=auto, but implementation and tests all touch the same prompt/runtime config seams and must preserve exact prompt-compatibility semantics. There is no safe independent file-ownership split, so no workflow room is needed.
contractBlockPlan: Phase A blocks: (1) role-specific guidance constants/strings in extensions/workflow/prompts.ts; (2) pure helpers such as isSemanticNavigationEnabledForRole/buildSemanticNavigationPromptGuidance/applySemanticNavigationPromptGuidance; (3) new smoke tests in scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts proving role text and disabled/off gating at helper level. No edits to extensions/brain-workflow.ts, delegate transport, or finalization gates. Phase B blocks: (4) wire getAgentPreset in extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts to append guidance to the effective AgentPreset using config.semanticNavigation; (5) expand smoke tests to cover loadWorkflowConfig + getAgentPreset enabled external config, disabled config, role off, and non-Serena default prompt compatibility; (6) optional doc clarification in docs/workflow-config-v2.md that semanticNavigation prompt guidance is gated and Serena output is not validation evidence. Validation commands: npx tsx --conditions import scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts plus relevant existing TASK-001/TASK-002 smokes.
acceptanceCriteria: Brain guidance emphasizes orientation, architecture understanding, and concrete file/symbol refs before delegation.
Coder guidance requires exact built-in file inspection before final edits and validation commands after semantic edits.
Reviewer guidance treats Serena output as review coverage, not behavioral evidence.
Serena guidance is absent when semanticNavigation is disabled or role is not enabled.
title: Role-specific Serena prompt guidance

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Brain guidance emphasizes orientation, architecture understanding, and concrete file/symbol refs before delegation.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Brain may delegate vague exploration work or miss architecture context, weakening the brain -> coder contract and increasing coder guesswork.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Brain effective guidance contains orientation, architecture understanding, concrete file/symbol refs, and self-contained delegation language.
Diff shows role-specific Brain guidance is added through config-gated prompt composition, not by weakening delegation rules.

blockingConditions: Brain guidance is generic/shared with other roles instead of role-specific.
Brain guidance omits concrete file/symbol references or self-contained delegation boundaries.
Guidance appears when semanticNavigation is disabled or role access is off.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Coder guidance requires exact built-in file inspection before final edits and validation commands after semantic edits.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Coder may rely on semantic edits without reading exact source or running validation, causing unsafe edits and false completion evidence.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Coder effective guidance requires built-in read/file inspection before final edits and validation commands after semantic edits.
Diff shows Coder guidance preserves existing validation/evidence rules and does not treat Serena output as sufficient validation.

blockingConditions: Coder guidance implies Serena edits can skip built-in file reads.
Coder guidance omits validation commands after semantic edits.
Coder guidance weakens existing coder evidence or quality gates.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Reviewer guidance treats Serena output as review coverage, not behavioral evidence.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Reviewer may approve based on semantic inspection alone, undermining finalization and behavior evidence boundaries.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Reviewer effective guidance says Serena output is review coverage/supporting context, not behavioral/runtime validation evidence.
Diff shows Reviewer guidance stays readonly and instructs changes when relevant call sites/diagnostics are unreviewed.

blockingConditions: Reviewer guidance says or implies semantic navigation proves behavior.
Reviewer guidance omits runtime/behavior evidence boundaries.
Reviewer guidance encourages edit/refactor tools for reviewer.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Serena guidance is absent when semanticNavigation is disabled or role is not enabled.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Default users or off roles would see irrelevant Serena instructions and might assume unavailable tools/evidence semantics are active.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts disabled config and per-role off config do not append Serena guidance to effective Brain/Coder/Reviewer prompts.
Existing TASK-001 config smoke remains green for absent/default disabled semanticNavigation.

blockingConditions: Guidance appears for default disabled config.
Guidance appears for roles set to off.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Existing installations could silently receive changed Brain/Coder/Reviewer behavior even without opting into Serena.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke compares disabled/default effective prompts to the existing base prompt constants and verifies no Serena guidance is appended.
